sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
This page surfaces the generated XML-comment-based API reference for PawSharp v1.0.0-alpha.2. The generator produced per-assembly JSON files which are available below. For fully browsable method signatures and examples, run tools/generate_docs.py locally after building the repository (requires .NET 10 + Python).

Generated assemblies: PawSharp.API, PawSharp.Core, PawSharp.Cache, PawSharp.Client, PawSharp.Commands, PawSharp.Gateway, PawSharp.Interactions, PawSharp.Interactivity, PawSharp.Voice.
